eligibility_text: Any Indian citizen aged 18-40 with a savings bank account or post-office account. Income-tax payers have been excluded from new enrolment since October 2022.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 / 2,000 / 3,000 / 4,000 or 5,000 from age 60, based on the contribution slab chosen at entry. Spouse receives the same pension after subscriber's death, then the nominee gets the accumulated corpus.
source_note: Core structure stable since 2015; double-check the exact contribution-to-pension slab table on npscra.nsdl.co.in before quoting numbers in the demo.
